 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            components.append((color, cells))
    objects = []
    for color, cells in components:
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        crop = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1+1)] for r in range(r0, r1+1)]
        objects.append((color, crop))
    objects.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    out_h = max(len(crop) for _, crop in objects)
    out = [[0] * sum(len(crop[0]) for _, crop in objects) for _ in range(out_h)]
    xoff = 0
    for _, crop in objects:
        for r in range(len(crop)):
            out[r][:][xoff:xoff+len(crop[0])] = crop[r]
        xoff += len(crop[0])
    return out
"
}
